title: CouchDB per-user databases
content: How couch_peruser auto-creates a private userdb-<hex> database for each account, and how provisioning installs the _design/auth validate_doc_update guard so anonymous reads work while only the owner can write.

replies.content: So anonymous reads are allowed but writes are guarded by the document update validation?
Exactly. The owner stays as admin; everyone else can only read.
